therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate with DNA alkylating agent
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of new brain metastases in HER2-positive breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: HER2-positive breast cancer patients with brain metastases following stereotactic radiosurgery
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase I: Maximum tolerated dose of temozolomide with T-DM1; Phase II: Time to new brain lesions

safety_signals: Grade 3/4 lymphocyte count decreased (highest at 50 mg/m² dose)
Grade 3 anemia, AST elevation, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia at higher doses
One case of chronic myeloid leukemia at highest dose level
No dose-limiting toxicities observed in first cycle
results.dose_information: T-DM1 3.6 mg/kg IV every 21 days; Temozolomide dose escalation: 30, 40, 50 mg/m² daily; MTD established at 40 mg/m²

context.comparator: T-DM1 alone versus T-DM1 plus temozolomide
